comment: Local advisory database used by the offline scanner. Entries are matched against the detected Nextcloud version using the half-open range [introduced, fixed). Ship your own entries here or point --vulnerability-feed at a JSON feed (GitHub Advisory API format is understood as well).

advisories.title: Unmaintained Nextcloud release
advisories.description: The detected release no longer receives security fixes. This entry is reported by the scanner itself when the updater server or the local instance flags the version as end-of-life; it is listed here for documentation only and is never matched by version range.
